title: Handshake message 2 payload
description: The JSON the engine encrypts in handshake message 2 (WELCOME). Message 1's payload is empty. A payload that is not this exact shape is refused (HANDSHAKE_FAILED). See CONTRACT.md, Vault channel, Handshake.

engineKey.description: The engine's signing public key: the 91-byte DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo (id-ecPublicKey, prime256v1, uncompressed point), base64url without padding.

sig.description: ECDSA P-256 SHA-256 signature, 64 bytes r||s, base64url, over the UTF-8 bytes of "basalt-vault-session-sig.1\n" followed by the 32 raw bytes of the handshake hash h after the e and ee tokens of message 2.
